<function name="SetWeapon" parent="CTakeDamageInfo" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the damage-inflicting weapon of the damage event.

This should be a <page>Weapon</page> entity, not a projectile. See also <page>CTakeDamageInfo:SetInflictor</page>.
	</description>
	<added>2025.01.15</added>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="" type="Entity">The damage-inflicting weapon or <page>NULL</page>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
